column1: # Known coverage gaps: one row per gap the archive can't close yet, read by `ea coverage`, the coverage pages, the polity hubs, and the twins.

# Columns: polity (us or a country code); state (US postal code, or a country's region code; blank for all); level (coverage level key, readiness key for grain candidates; blank for all); stage (general, primary, runoff, special; blank for all); years (YYYY, YYYY-YYYY, or YYYY- for open-ended); grain (results, county, precinct, fine, shapes, turnout, candidates, dates, party); label (what the row covers, shown on pages); ids (space-separated contest uuids, or for candidates government polity uuids or county FIPS codes; blank for every match); category (known_gap: sources exhausted; blocked: a source exists but can't be reached yet; not_applicable: the grain doesn't exist); reason (one public sentence, through copydesk); sources (what was tried); checked (YYYY-MM-DD); ref (request id).

# A grain covers itself and finer ones (results, then county, then precinct). The most specific matching row wins: ids, then state, stage, level, the narrower years, and the earlier row. Rows that no longer match anything short drop off the pages; delete them when a source turns up.
